children: On Thursday, Iran-backed Houthis reportedly seized Yemen’s key Red Sea port of Mocha and advanced toward strategically important islands.

S&P 500 futures
gained 9.50 points, or 0.13%, to 7,608.00.
Nasdaq 100 futures
slipped 4.50 points, or 0.02%, to 29,130.75 as of around 8:45 p.m. EDT.
In commodities,
WTI crude oil
rose 0.78% to $103.28 per barrel, while
Brent crude
advanced 0.85% to $108.54 per barrel. Natural gas futures fell 0.07% to $2.832 per MMBtu.
